parameters.content:
## Take website forms into Google Sheets, with a double opt-in newsletter

One webhook for a site's contact form and newsletter band. Messages and the subscriber list land in a sheet, senders join your contact book, and a morning briefing can print what came in.

### How it works
1. Checks every submission and answers the site only after the row is written, so the form can say honestly whether it worked.
2. Stores a contact message as one row and adds the sender to the contact book.
3. Mails one confirmation link for a newsletter request and holds the address as pending, with limits per address and per hour.
4. Confirms or unsubscribes when the button behind that link is pressed on your site.
5. Renders a briefing section of the last day's messages and list changes when another workflow calls it.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Create two tabs in one spreadsheet: `Messages` (ts, email, name, message, path) and `Subscribers` (email, state, token, requested_at, path, confirmed_at, unsubscribed_at, mails)
- [ ] Connect a Google Sheets credential and pick that spreadsheet, and your contact sheet, in each Sheets node
- [ ] Create a Header Auth credential named `X-Forms-Secret` with a long random value, bind it to **When Form Is Sent**, and have your site send the same header
- [ ] Create a Header Auth credential for your mail service (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`) and bind it to **Send Confirmation Mail**
- [ ] Fill in **Set Site Config**: site name, the page the mailed link opens, the sender address

[Project page and the site side](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/17_site-forms/README.md)

## Receive and check a form

Only a sender holding the shared secret gets in. The settings live in one node; the check turns the body into one of four routes.

nodes.name: When Form Is Sent
nodes.notes:
Body: kind (contact | newsletter | confirm | unsubscribe), email, name, message, path, token.
The site mints the token for a newsletter request; a server has a real random source.

nodes.name: Set Site Config
nodes.notes:
confirm_page: the page on YOUR site the mailed link opens. It shows a button and posts the token back; this workflow never serves a page.
mail_from: e.g. Example <no-reply@example.com>, on a domain verified with your mail service.

parameters.content:
## Store a contact message

One row per message, then the answer to the site.

nodes.name: Append Message Row
nodes.notes: A raw append with INSERT_ROWS, not the Sheets node: two messages arriving together would otherwise overwrite one another. RAW keeps a message that starts with = from running as a formula.

parameters.content:
## Start the double opt-in

Reads the list, decides whether a mail is due, sends it and only then stores the address as pending. The answer is the same whether or not a mail went out.

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ [ 'Someone asked to subscribe this address to updates from ' + $('Set Site Config').first().json.site_name + '.', '', 'If that was you, confirm here:', $('Set Site Config').first().json.confirm_page + '?a=confirm&t=' + $('Validate Form').first().json.token, '', 'If it was not you, ignore this mail and the address is not added.', '', 'This address does not take replies.' ].join('\n') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $('Set Site Config').first().json.mail_from, to: [$('Validate Form').first().json.email], subject: $json.subject, text: $json.text }) }}

nodes.name: Send Confirmation Mail
nodes.notes: Any transactional mail API works; only this URL and body differ. The mail goes first and the row second: a failed send leaves no pending address behind.

nodes.name: Upsert Subscriber in Sheets
nodes.notes: confirmed_at and unsubscribed_at are left out on purpose: asking again must not erase when an address joined or left.

parameters.content:
## Confirm or unsubscribe by token

The token finds its one row. A confirm link works once and expires; an unsubscribe link always works. An unknown or spent token is answered 422, as is any submission that failed the check.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, state: $('Decide Token Change').first().json.state }) }}

parameters.content:
## Update the contact book

Both branches hand over the same small change. It is joined with the contact's existing row, so a known contact keeps everything a form has no business touching.

## Render the briefing section

Called by the morning briefing with a time zone and a window. Returns exactly one item: the messages in full and who asked, confirmed or left.

nodes.name: When Called for Briefing
nodes.notes:
tz: IANA time zone
window_hours: how far back to look
